messages:
SRE Bot: INCIDENT ALERT: spike in 5xx for /v1/generate originating from eu-west region. anomaly detector 0.82 -> paging on-call. dashboard: https://dash.redwood.internal/incidents/1876543210 :rotating_light:

Alice Chen: acked. I'm oncall, looking now. paging neteng for cross-region routing check.

Miguel Torres: seeing increased latency and missing KV cache hits for requests routed to eu-west but served from us-east. likely routing policy misroute. grabbing traces.

Kira Patel: can you paste the affected tenant list? want to notify CS if any enterprise customers are impacted.

Alice Chen: affected tenants: [AcmeCorp, BrightLedger, NoteWave]. error rates: AcmeCorp 14% 5xx, BrightLedger 9%, NoteWave 6%. all traffic shows origin geo eu-west but backend footprints in us-east.

SRE Bot: Pager escalation to Neteng team +1 (neteng-pager).

Miguel Torres: quick check: Route decision logs show this policy match: 
```
policy_id: route-by-latency-v2
match: request.client_region == "eu-west" && backend.load < 0.7
action: select(closest_region)
```
but actual decision tree later prefers us-east due to stale region weight metadata (weights store TTL mismatch).

Neteng Bot: Detected delta in region weights config. Consul key /routing/region_weights/eu-west missing recent update (ttl=0). Reconciler failed to write at 2024-11-12T03:05Z.

Alice Chen: mitigation plan: 1) temporarily pin eu-west traffic to eu-west model pools 2) roll forward corrected region weights 3) monitor 5xx and latency. Applying step 1 now:
```
# temporary override
redwood route override set --match "client_region==eu-west" --force-region eu-west --expiry 15m
```

Miguel Torres: override applied. I see traffic shifting back to eu-west model pool. 5xx rate dropping from 12% -> 2.2% for AcmeCorp within 2m. :thumbsup:

Kira Patel: notifying CS and account leads for AcmeCorp and BrightLedger. small incident email draft in #customer-success queued.

Alice Chen: next, reconcile region weights. Neteng, can you confirm source of ttl drift?

Neteng Bot: root cause: automated rollout job that updates /routing/region_weights runs every 5m; last deployment temporarily disabled write due to bug in leader election when a controller pod restarts in eu-west-2 AZ. Patch in flight: leader logic didn't re-acquire lock quickly causing a write to be skipped without error.

Miguel Torres: patch looks good. rolling patch to reconciler now. command: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/routing-reconciler -n infra`

Neteng Bot: reconciler restarted, write completed, verified weights consistency across regions. TTL restored to 300s.

Alice Chen: removing temp override in 10m after monitoring stable for 5m post-weight fix.

SRE Bot: METRIC: /v1/generate 5xx for eu-west reduced to baseline. latency back within SLO.

Oncall Pager: brief customer impact summary for postmortem: 3 enterprise customers saw elevated 5xx and increased latency for ~18 minutes. No data loss; requests retried by SDKs. Potential business impact: minor SLA exposure, CS outreach required.

Kira Patel: copied required artifacts to incident workspace: traces, route decision logs, reconciler logs, and the one-line reconciliation fix. filing RFO ticket: RFO-1876543210.

Alice Chen: handing off to night oncall Kira Patel for watch and follow-up. Handoff notes: override applied then removed, reconciler patched, watch for stale consul keys, look at controller restarts in eu-west-2 AZ. Playbook link: https://playbooks.redwood/internal/incidents/routing-ttl-drift

Kira Patel: acknowledged handoff. will follow up with postmortem doc and CS outreach. adding action item: add guard in reconciler to emit a non-silent error if write skipped.

Miguel Torres: one more note — we should add a synthetic check that validates region_weights TTL fresh every 60s and pages neteng if delta > 30s. filing infra task.

SRE Bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: mitigation succeeded and automated fix deployed. closing timeline and moving to postmortem state.

Alice Chen: thanks everyone. nice quick coordination. I'll draft the timeline and hand off to Kira for RFO. :tada:
